carrier_line.bell: Plans billed monthly, with iPhone and Android handsets to choose from. Bell SmartPay can spread a handset’s cost across 24 monthly payments.
carrier_line.virgin-plus: Most plans come with Member Benefits, a set of perks that costs nothing extra. Everything is billed monthly.
carrier_line.lucky-mobile: Paid a month ahead, so no bill ever follows. No credit check is made, and nothing commits you beyond the month you have paid for.

repairs.title: Cracked screens and glass
repairs.text: New glass or a new screen for a phone or tablet that has taken a fall.

repairs.title: Tired batteries
repairs.text: For a phone that is flat by lunchtime, shuts down with charge left, or has a battery that is visibly bulging.

repairs.title: Charging faults
repairs.text: A charger that no longer seems to work, or a cable that must be held at a certain angle before the phone will charge.

repairs.title: Camera and rear panel
repairs.text: A scratched or split camera lens, pictures that come out soft, or a rear panel that has shattered.

repairs.title: Speaker and microphone
repairs.text: A caller you can barely hear, a speaker that has gone thin, or a microphone that no longer picks you up.

repairs.title: After a soaking
repairs.text: A handset that has been soaked should be powered down at once and brought to us promptly.

faq.a: No. You are welcome {{ hours_phrase }}. Booking is optional; it simply lets us hold time for you.

faq.q: What becomes of my number if I change provider?
faq.a: It goes with you. In Canada a phone number can move to a new provider. The account number printed on a recent bill is what the transfer needs, so please bring one, along with photo ID in case it is requested. Leave your existing plan untouched until the transfer is complete; the move itself brings that service to an end.
Those of Bell, Virgin Plus and Lucky Mobile. As a Bell Authorised Retailer we also arrange Bell home internet, TV and a home phone line.

faq.q: Can a tablet be repaired too?
faq.a: Yes, a tablet is as welcome as a phone. Once we know the model and the fault, we will quote you a price; work begins only if you agree.

faq.q: Is the entrance suitable for a wheelchair?
faq.a: Wheelchair users can come in by the store’s accessible entrance. For another access question, ring us before you visit.
